verdict.rationale: The docs show a structured response rather than a plain text blob: word- and character-level timestamps (docs-12), speaker labels from diarization (docs-5, docs-7), and separate fields such as 'edited_transcript' returned alongside the original transcript (docs-8). A community user also describes editing text inside the word-timestamp objects (comm-1), which corroborates per-word structure. However, the pack never mentions confidence values or utterance/segment-level grouping. Missing for 10: documented per-word or per-segment confidence scores, explicit utterance/segment objects in the JSON schema, an example response payload.
